name: Sweet Dreams! Pajamas Set
come_from: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
lore: Pom-Pom's pajamas, which they wear to bed at home, are not usually shown to others... unless they're too sleepy to notice. The light blue base color resembles the morning sky. Some passengers think the white fluffy ball on the hat tip is imitating the Pepeshi people, but that's just a baseless rumor.
